title: Halo Dental heading
description: Big regular-weight headings with tight leading: a 64px section size, a 100px mega size and a 28px card size, each scaled down for phones. The mega size can carry a yellow-to-red gradient fill.
notes: the gradient uses the theme's highlight and glow colours; best on dark panels
name: halodental-opus-heading

props.name: size
props.description:
section: 40px on phones, 64px on desktop · mega: 50px on phones, 100px on desktop ·
card: 25px → 28px (news titles, footer columns)

props.name: gradient
props.description: paint the letters with the highlight → glow gradient (yellow to red)
